title: benchmarks.py pool build rebuilds the committed pool without a paid call and picks a fact line, never front matter
goal: An offline pool build on today's tree reproduces kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv row for row (new lookup_eval.csv rows do not move the stratified sample, or the build keeps the committed sample) and asks no Sonnet call for a row it already has, as bench_pool.py's docstring says; fact_for never picks a front-matter line (applies_to:, topic:) as a row's fact, so fewer eval rows fall back to a path-only check. Found by the SP-hm4qgf3t review: a rebuild replaced BP-c552cb0f with BP-ae1e4987 and 10 of 40 eval rows have path-only checks.

gates.question: How does a pool rebuild keep the committed sample when the eval set grows?
options: The build keeps the eval rows and near-miss bases of the file at --out and draws only the rows it lacks; a build to a new --out resamples
The build keeps the sample only when --seed equals a seed recorded in the file
The build resamples by a hash of seed and case id, so an added case may displace a row
gates.recommendation: The build keeps the eval rows and near-miss bases of the file at --out and draws only the rows it lacks; a build to a new --out resamples
gates.answer: The build keeps the eval rows and near-miss bases of the file at --out and draws only the rows it lacks; a build to a new --out resamples

gates.question: What does an offline rebuild do with a committed path-only check whose fact line was a front-matter line?
options: It keeps the committed check and asks no model; a later paid call can redo them
It drops the committed check and asks the model again
gates.recommendation: It keeps the committed check and asks no model; a later paid call can redo them
gates.answer: It keeps the committed check and asks no model; a later paid call can redo them

notes: Blocks the next pool benchmark record: the operator asked on 2026-10-08 for the work needed before the next record to be staged as SP-2vhfsn4o. Premise (SP-hm4qgf3t review, 2026-10-08): an offline build_public differs from the committed pool by one row (BP-c552cb0f replaced by BP-ae1e4987) and would ask Sonnet for claude/enterprise-admin.md:94; fact_for picks front-matter lines, and 10 of 40 eval rows have path-only checks. Both checks pass before the work and pin the pool; the work adds a rebuild-equality assertion to the existing bench_pool build test, its failing proof.
